install.title: Arrow Up
install.label: Install Arrow Up
install.subtitle: Run as a dedicated, standalone app
install.standaloneDesc: Distraction-free window with faster launch and no browser tab clutter.
install.offlineDesc: Access your tasks, habits, and journals even with zero internet.
install.quickDesc: Pins straight to your home screen or system taskbar.
install.iosStep1: 1. Tap the Share icon in the Safari toolbar
install.iosStep2: 2. Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen"
install.androidStep1: 1. Tap the browser menu (⋮) in the top or bottom bar
install.androidStep2: 2. Select "Install app" or "Add to Home screen"
install.desktopDesc: Click the install icon (⊕) in your browser's address bar, or open the browser menu (⋮) and select "Install Arrow Up".
install.mobileInstallReady: Arrow Up is ready to install onto your home screen for instant, distraction-free access.
install.desktopInstallReady: Install Arrow Up as a dedicated desktop app for faster launch and window isolation.

default.title: Arrow Up Guide
default.subtitle: Boost your personal momentum and achieve daily clarity.
default.tip1Desc: Use the bottom bar to switch between Todos, Journals, and Framework.
default.tip2Desc: All data stays cached locally so you can continue uninterrupted even with no connection.
default.tip3Desc: Small consistent actions done every single day compound into life-changing results.

todos.title: Todos & Missions Guide
todos.subtitle: Master your daily schedule and build consistent momentum.
todos.tip1Desc: Organize your focus across Today's tasks, Upcoming targets, and multi-step Missions.
todos.tip2Desc: Missions let you track strategic goals with time and energy cost ratings and concrete sub-actions.
todos.tip3Desc: Tap '+' to schedule new daily habits, upcoming deadlines, or major missions.

todosNew.title: New Todo / Mission Guide
todosNew.subtitle: Create actionable tasks or structured strategic missions.
todosNew.tip1Desc: Select Daily for time-bound habits, Upcoming for calendar targets, or Mission for milestones.
todosNew.tip2Desc: Assign a time and energy cost scale from 1 (easy) to 5 (epic) to weight high-leverage missions.
todosNew.tip3Desc: Break down major missions into specific milestone checkpoints with dates.

journals.title: Daily Journals Guide
journals.subtitle: Reflect on thoughts, learnings, and personal growth.
journals.tip1Desc: Writing down observations and daily wins clears cognitive clutter and increases gratitude.
journals.tip2Desc: Filter entries by Logs, Thoughts, Feelings, Lessons, Ideas, or Notes.
journals.tip3Desc: Revisiting past journal notes reveals patterns in your decision-making and emotional states.

journalsNew.title: New Journal Entry Guide
journalsNew.subtitle: Capture your reflections, insights, and moments of gratitude.
journalsNew.tip1Desc: Write authentic notes about what worked today, lessons learned, and ideas for tomorrow.
journalsNew.tip2Desc: Choose among Logs, Thoughts, Feelings, Lessons, Ideas, or Notes to categorize your entry.
journalsNew.tip3Desc: Use the TipTap rich editor to structure your writing with headings, lists, and formatting.

framework.title: Framework Guide
framework.subtitle: Ground your life in sovereign visions, clear rules, and mental models.
framework.tip1Desc: Visions define what ultimate mastery and fulfillment look like in each area of your life.
framework.tip2Desc: Rules serve as non-negotiable boundaries and automated decision filters.
framework.tip3Desc: Concepts store timeless mental models and playbooks you can review anytime.

frameworkNew.title: New Framework Item Guide
frameworkNew.subtitle: Articulate a core vision, boundary rule, or mental model.
frameworkNew.tip1Desc: Choose the most relevant life domain (Career, Mindset, Health, Finance, etc.).
frameworkNew.tip2Desc: Decide whether this is a long-term Vision, an operational Rule, or an educational Concept.
frameworkNew.tip3Desc: Use the TipTap editor to format key takeaways, bullet lists, and principles.

profile.title: Profile & Settings Guide
profile.subtitle: Personalize your experience and manage preferences.
profile.tip1Desc: Switch between English and Persian, or Dark and Light themes with instant persistence.
profile.tip2Desc: Review high-level summaries of all your recorded todos, journals, and framework items.
profile.tip3Desc: Easily manage your login session or log out whenever you need.

search.title: Search Guide
search.subtitle: Find tasks, journals, and framework items instantly.
search.tip1Desc: Type keywords to quickly locate items across all your life modules.
search.tip2Desc: Use titles or categories to narrow down results effortlessly.
search.tip3Desc: Search indexes your tasks, journal entries, and framework items in one unified view.
